title: Error Stitchboard — Compact Debug Lens Prototype for Console Triage Flow
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Problem: On-call engineers and PMs running triage workflows need a lightweight, single-pane way to examine failed requests, correlate retries, and make quick rollback/rollout decisions without losing session context. Existing Console panels are too heavy for rapid triage (many clicks to load full request traces) and surface raw payloads without structured diffs or cost guidance.

Goal: Design a compact ‘Stitchboard’ lens that sits inline inside list rows and expands into a small overlay. It should: 1) show the failed request summary (status, model, route, latency), 2) present a concise visual timeline of retries and fallbacks, 3) expose parsed payload fields with side‑by‑side diff for the most recent retry pair, 4) annotate token-cost delta and KV-cache hit/miss indicators, and 5) provide quick actions (replay, re-run with breakpoint, open full trace, add to follow-up bug).

Constraints: Should not duplicate the full Debug Workspace. Must be keyboard accessible and performant for result sets of 500+ rows. UX must make safe defaults for customer privacy (mask PII by default) and respect data retention policies. Interaction patterns must map to existing Console permissions (so actions that mutate state must require appropriate role).

Success metrics: reduce mean triage time by 30% in pilot group, increase use of in-line replay from 8% to 40% of triage sessions, and reduce full trace opens for transient errors by 25%.
acceptance_criteria: Compact lens opens inline from a result row and overlays without full page navigation
Timeline visualizes at least three retry events and highlights fallback model switches
Payload diff shows parsed fields and raw payload toggles; default view is parsed with PII masked
Token-cost delta is computed and displayed for each retry interval with hover breakdown
Quick actions available: Replay (read-only), Re-run with breakpoint (sandboxed), Open full trace, Add to incident list
Design handoff assets include accessible color tokens, keyboard flow, and annotated Figma frames
tasks: Finalize final screens and microcopy in Figma (Aisha) — frame A/B for timeline density
Review API surface with Eng (Marco) to confirm required request context fields (timestamp, kv-cache flags, token_cost_breakdown)
Create prototype with interactive diff toggles and cost tooltip (Aisha)
Write accessibility spec: keyboard sequence, ARIA roles, focus states (Aisha)
Engineering spike: measure overlay render time on result sets of 1k rows and return perf numbers (ENG-4021)
Add story for Console e2e tests to cover replay and action gating based on RBAC
decisions: Default payload view will be parsed fields with a single-click Raw toggle to avoid overwhelming users
PII will be masked by default; opt-in to reveal via a separate permission and explicit audit log
Timeline will prioritize retries and model-fallbacks; full span-level flamechart pushed to full trace panel
Token-cost delta is shown as an inline numeric delta with a tooltip linking to cost breakdown dashboard
Compact lens will use existing Console action menu patterns to reduce cognitive load and dev effort
